subject: [PATCH v4 07/14] SUNRPC: stop svc_register() once rpcbind stops answering

2026-08-31.patch_summary: This patch modifies the svc_register function in the SUNRPC module to stop registering programs and versions when the local rpcbind client times out, rather than continuing to try other programs and versions. This change is made to prevent unnecessary delays and wasted time when a program's call to the local rpcbind times out. The approach taken is to add a new condition that breaks out of the loop if no answer was received from the rpcbind client.
